fields.description: Safa Gate is DAMAC's apartment tower on Sheikh Zayed Road beside Safa Park. Its original release combines one- and two-bedroom apartments with larger three- and five-bedroom penthouses. Shared gardens, viewing decks and an extensive leisure programme form part of the proposed building.

research.community: Safa Gate · Sheikh Zayed Road / Safa Park
overview: The design combines projecting terraces, shared gardens and leisure spaces above street level. The concept brochure presents a range of indoor and outdoor settings; views, finish schedules and access to individual facilities should be checked against the chosen apartment and its contract.
research.locationNote: DAMAC places Safa Gate along Sheikh Zayed Road on the edge of Safa Park, near Safa One and Safa Two. Property Finder identifies the wider area as AlWasl. Confirm the particular plot, building entrance and safe pedestrian routes rather than inferring access from a marketing map.
research.priceNote: The branded launch sheet starts one-bedroom homes at AED 1.997m and two-bedroom homes at AED 2.772m. Its three- and five-bedroom penthouse guides are AED 15.894m and AED 25.205m. These historical references do not confirm current availability or the entry price of later releases.
research.paymentNote: The reviewed regular plan is 20% immediately, 60% during construction and 20% on completion. It includes 1% monthly instalments with 5% milestones at months 18,30 and 42. A different launch sheet uses 20/50/30; the two schedules must not be combined. Both add 4% DLD to the initial deposit; confirm today's offer.
research.handoverNote: The reviewed regular and launch documents estimate 31 October 2029, expressed here asQ 4 2029. A developer estimate is not a guarantee; confirm the selected unit's contractual date.
